description: Find web pages semantically similar to a given URL — discover related content, competitors, alternatives without knowing what to search for. Unique capability for research agents (Exa)

exclude_source_domain.description: Exclude results from same domain as input URL (default true)

include_text.description: Include full extracted page text (default false)

start_published_date.description: Only include similar pages published after this date (ISO format)

url.description: Reference URL — Exa finds pages semantically similar to this one

name: search.semantic.similar

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Find Similar Pages (Exa)
